_comment: Tier-2 for febio::heat#1. All three spellings of a Fourier conduction material ("isotropic Fourier", "Fourier", "isotropic_Fourier") give 'tag "material" (line N) : invalid value for attribute "type"' with 'Reading file ...FAILED!' — there is no short or underscore variant that works, which is the specific thing the pitfall asserts. Positive control: the shipped heat_3d_bar / biphasic_3d_confined template, unmodified, which runs to normal termination — so the message is attributable to the single thing that was changed. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
